name: conts-scm-engine
description: Conts's copy of the Houzs supply chain engine. backend/ and frontend/ each have their own package.json.

scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint -- --advisory && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.lint:update: npm --prefix backend run lint:update && npm --prefix frontend run lint:update
